english.meaning: to mix up or mess up
english.note: 又撈亂咗 means messed it up again.

exampleSentences.english: Done. Ah, damn, I’ve mixed it up again.
exampleSentences.traditional: 搞掂嚹。吖，哎吔，死嚹，又撈亂咗喎但係又。
